additionalAbilities.description:
Bonus Action. Braxton rages for 10 minutes, gaining resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage, advantage on Strength checks and saves, and +3 damage on Strength-based weapon attacks. He cannot cast spells or maintain Concentration. Rage ends early if he becomes Unconscious, dons Heavy armor, or ends it as a Bonus Action. He regains one use after a Short Rest and all uses after a Long Rest.

additionalAbilities.description:

additionalAbilities.description: While unarmored, Braxton has AC 17 (10 + Dexterity modifier + Constitution modifier).
additionalAbilities.name: Unarmored Defense
Frenzy
additionalAbilities.description: While raging and using Reckless, the first target Braxton hits on his turn with a Strength-based attack takes an extra 3d6 damage of the weapon's type.

additionalAbilities.name: Mindless Rage
additionalAbilities.description: While raging, Braxton is immune to Charmed and Frightened. Entering Rage ends those conditions on him.

additionalAbilities.name: Danger Sense
additionalAbilities.description: Braxton has advantage on Dexterity saves unless he is Incapacitated.

additionalAbilities.name: Persistent Rage
additionalAbilities.description: Rage lasts its full duration without needing to be extended. Once per Long Rest, Braxton can regain all expended Rage uses when he rolls Initiative.
